findings.issue: One fine unit merged the requirement that an unformatted derived-type effective item is treated as a single value with the permission that its form is processor dependent, and its round-trip plan could not distinguish single-value from component-list treatment.
findings.resolution: Split into S12.6.3-016 (requirement) and S12.6.3-028 (permission). Neither has a portable oracle: a same-type round trip succeeds under either representation, reading into a different list is processor dependent by 12.6.4.5.2 p6, and IOLENGTH and record layout are processor dependent.

census_mismatch: The reader labels two units note3 and note4, but each holds the boxed NOTE prose followed by normative p8 bullets; a visual PDF check by the reviewer confirmed this. Only the boxed prose is treated as informative. Recorded as followup source-census-note-boundary-12-6-3.
